description_en: Queries the details of a specified rule action
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定规则动作的详细信息
name: GetRuleAction

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page is displayed or no </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule action to query.

You can obtain the rule action ID by using the following methods:
Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69586.html and view the value of the ActionId parameter in the response.
Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69517.html and view the value of the Id parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的规则动作ID。

您可以通过以下方式查询规则动作ID：
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69586.html，返回的**ActionId**参数值。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69517.html，返回的**Id**参数值
parameters.name: action_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

RuleActionInfo.description_en: The details of the rule action returned if the call was successful. For more information, see the following parameters
RuleActionInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的规则动作详细信息。详情参见以下参数

Configuration.description_en: The configuration information of the rule action
Configuration.description_zh: 该规则动作的配置信息

ErrorActionFlag.description_en:
Indicates whether this rule action forwards error operation data, which is data that failed to be forwarded to other cloud services and failed after retries.

true: The rule action forwards error operation data.
false: The rule action does not forward error operation data. Instead, it performs normal forwarding operations
ErrorActionFlag.description_zh:
该规则动作是否为转发错误操作数据的转发动作，即转发流转到其他云产品失败且重试失败的数据。

true：该规则动作转发错误操作数据。
false：该规则动作不转发错误操作数据，而是正常转发操作

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the rule that corresponds to the rule action
RuleId.description_zh: 该规则动作对应的规则ID

Type.description_en:
The type of the rule action. Valid values:

REPUBLISH: forwards data to another topic.
OTS: stores data in Tablestore.
MNS: sends data to Message Service.
<props="china">- ONS: sends data to Message Queue.</props>
<props="china">- TSDB: stores data in Time Series Database (TSDB).</props>
FC: sends data to Function Compute.
<props="china">- DATAHUB: sends data to DataHub.</props>
RDS: stores data in ApsaraDB.
AMQP: forwards data to an AMQP consumer group
Type.description_zh:
规则动作类，取值：

REPUBLISH：转发到另一个topic。
OTS：存储到表格存储。
MNS：发送消息到消息服务。
<props="china">- ONS：发送数据到消息队列。</props>
<props="china">- TSDB：存储到高性能时间序列数据库。</props>
FC：发送数据到函数计算。
<props="china">- DATAHUB：发送数据到DataHub中。</props>
RDS：存储数据到云数据库中。
AMQP：数据流转到AMQP消费组

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
